name: @taulabs/openrscad-engine
description: Tau's fork of the OpenRSCAD geometry engine, compiled to WebAssembly — parse .scad source and render solid 3D meshes in the browser or Node. Adds an authored-scene GLB/3MF export path with source-derived feature edges; tracks upstream.
author: Matt Hova

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:facade
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/openrscad-wasm --release --target web --out-dir "$PWD/pkg/web" --out-name openrscad && wasm-pack build ../../crates/openrscad-wasm --release --target nodejs --out-dir "$PWD/pkg/node" --out-name openrscad && rm -f pkg/web/.gitignore pkg/node/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:profile: wasm-pack build ../../crates/openrscad-wasm --release --target web --out-dir "$PWD/pkg/web" --out-name openrscad -- --features benchmark-profile && wasm-pack build ../../crates/openrscad-wasm --release --target nodejs --out-dir "$PWD/pkg/node" --out-name openrscad -- --features benchmark-profile && rm -f pkg/web/.gitignore pkg/node/.gitignore
